content_zh:
林锐的心里也是猛然一紧，转过头看着金浩山。
“我观察过，这是一个老式的苏联军事基地，主要都是修建在山腹里。门口的那些人虽然难对付，但是我们可以不走大门。”金浩山压低声音道，“我还有个朋友是工程兵出身，我和他都计算过，这里的房间有个地方是比较薄弱的。如果我们能够搞到炸药，或许可以炸出一条路来。”
秦奋神色一动，低声道，“你能肯定？”
“错不了，他是定向爆破专家。我和他一起用步伐测量过大致的距离，这里有一个地方，距离外面除了八十公分的钢筋混凝土，只有一米多的岩层，如果我们有足够的炸药，完全是能够从这里逃出去的。而且那个地方不在大门的位置，可以避开那些守卫。”金浩山低声道。
林锐突然一把抓起他，低声喝道，“你最好不要有这个念头。你即便是搞到了炸药，炸开了一条路，你以为你能跑出去多远？你当这训练营的其他人都是吃素的么？外面冰天雪地，零下四五十度的低温。你觉得你能跑多远？到时候，你不光会害死自己，还会连累其他人。”
金浩山脸色有些发白地道，“我也只是说说而已。”
“不能说，甚至不能想。在这个地方，任何一个错误的想法，都足以害死你！”林锐低声喝道，“你以为他们是些什么人？能够用前苏的军事基地作为训练营，各种武器装备，并且拥有外面这些高素质的军事守卫。这都不是一般公司能够做到的。合同的你自己愿意签的，如果你现在选择反悔，那么只有死路一条。”
秦奋的脸色有些不自然，他小声道，“其实我早就想到了，据说佣兵的的训练很残酷。你们说，我们要是通不过训练的，会不会……”他没有说下去，但是林锐和金浩山都清楚他的意思。
林锐摇摇头道，“这个还不清楚，不过我想我们这些人都是他们经过挑选之后招募的。大部分军事素质不错，应该不会有你说的这种情况发生。既来之则安之，千万不要有什么危险的想法。”
金浩山和秦奋都不说话了，两人沉默了很久。秦奋还是忍不住了，他问林锐道，“兄弟，那依你看我们现在该怎么办？”
“睡觉。”林锐看了他一眼道，“我们有六个小时的时间休息。如果不想拖着疲惫的身体去应付下一次训练，最好就是充分休息。这见鬼的佣兵训练才刚刚开始，以后有的是罪受。”说完这句话，他躺在了床上努力使自己平静下来，迷迷糊糊地睡了一会儿。
林锐说得一点都没有错，很快又是训练时间了。休息的时间短暂的令人绝望，在勉强睡了几个小时之后，他们又被集合了起来，带到了基地之中的训练大厅。
这一次依然是赵建飞给他们上课，所教授的依然是武器知识。依然是忙碌地分解组合各种武器，然后由赵建飞讲解每一种武器的特性和技术数据。没有人敢再多说一个字，因为他们都知道，在这里只有命令和服从。赵建飞的训练很简单，谁能够在一堆武器零件之中快速分拣组装成可以射击的枪械，并且在他规定的时间内完成实弹击发，谁就可以休息。否则就是重复练习。
林锐和大部分学员一样，都没能达到赵建飞的要求，所以不断地在分组练习。
秦奋有些忍不住道，“赵教官，你这标准是不是有点太高了。这一堆零部件，至少有几十种不同型号的枪械。要在两分钟之内分拣零件并且组装成功，还要完成实弹射击。这……”
“武器是战士的生命，不熟悉武器就是对自己生命的漠视。”赵建飞冷冷地走到他身边，用极快的速度完成了枪械的组装，并且快速在身后的射击靶位上射击。然后缓缓地地道，“这只是起步，我要求你们做的还不止是这些。当武器入手之后，你们要在最短的时间内熟悉性能。因为每一把枪无论生产再统一，它们的射击性能都不会是绝对标准的。在射击的时候，精准度都会有所偏移。这个时候才是最考验枪手的。”
赵建飞淡淡地道，“真正的好枪手，能够通过一两发子弹的射击之后，完成对枪械的调试，懂得依靠自我的手感来修正弹道。这绝不是一件简单的事情，而你们现在要做的还只是基础。”

content_en:
Lin Rui's heart suddenly tightened and he turned his head to look at Jin Haoshan.
"I have observed that this is an old-fashioned Soviet military base, mainly built in the middle of the mountain. Although the people at the door are difficult to deal with, we can not go through the door." Jin Haoshan lowered his voice, "I also have a friend who is an engineer. He and I have calculated that there is a place in the room here that is relatively weak. If we can get explosives, we may be able to blow out a way."
Qin Fen's expression changed and he whispered, "Are you sure?"
"You can't be wrong, he is an expert in directional blasting. I have measured the approximate distance with our steps. There is a place here. Apart from 80 centimeters of reinforced concrete, there is only a rock formation of more than one meter. If we have enough explosives, we can escape from here. And that place is not near the gate, so we can avoid the guards." Jin Haoshan said in a low voice.
Lin Rui suddenly grabbed him and shouted in a low voice, "You'd better not have this idea. Even if you get explosives and blow up a road, how far do you think you can run out? Do you think everyone else in this training camp is vegetarian? It's freezing and snowy outside, with temperatures as low as minus 40 or 50 degrees. How far do you think you can run? By then, you will not only kill yourself, but also implicate other people."
Jin Haoshan's face turned a little pale and he said, "I'm just talking."
"You can't say it, you can't even think about it. In this place, any wrong idea is enough to kill you!" Lin Rui shouted in a low voice, "Who do you think they are? They can use the military base of the former Soviet Union as a training camp, various weapons and equipment, and have these high-quality military guards from outside. This is not what ordinary companies can do. You are willing to sign the contract. If you choose to go back on it now, then you will only die."
Qin Fen's face looked a little unnatural, and he whispered, "Actually, I have thought of it a long time ago. It is said that the training of mercenaries is very cruel. Do you think, if we fail the training, will..." He did not continue, but Lin Rui and Jin Haoshan both knew what he meant.
Lin Rui shook his head and said, "I don't know about this yet, but I think we are all recruited by them after selection. Most of them have good military quality, so the situation you mentioned should not happen. Just make peace with it when you come, and don't have any dangerous ideas."
Jin Haoshan and Qin Fen stopped talking, and they were silent for a long time. Qin Fen couldn't help it anymore and asked Lin Rui, "Brother, what do you think we should do now?"
"Sleep." Lin Rui glanced at him and said, "We have six hours to rest. If you don't want to drag your tired body to deal with the next training, it's best to get enough rest. This damn mercenary training has just begun, and there will be a lot of suffering in the future." After saying this, he lay on the bed and tried to calm down, and fell asleep for a while.
What Lin Rui said was absolutely correct, it will soon be training time again. The rest period was hopelessly short. After barely sleeping for a few hours, they were gathered together again and taken to the training hall in the base.
This time, Zhao Jianfei was still teaching them, and he was still teaching weapons knowledge. He was still busy disassembling and combining various weapons, and then Zhao Jianfei explained the characteristics and technical data of each weapon. No one dared to say another word, because they all knew that there were only orders and obedience here. Zhao Jianfei's training is very simple. Whoever can quickly sort and assemble a gun from a pile of weapon parts into a gun that can be fired, and complete the firing of live ammunition within the time specified by him, can rest. Otherwise it's just practice repetition.
Lin Rui, like most students, failed to meet Zhao Jianfei's requirements, so he continued to practice in groups.
Qin Fen couldn't help but said, "Instructor Zhao, is this your standard?"A little too high. There are at least dozens of different models of firearms in this pile of parts. The parts must be sorted and assembled successfully within two minutes, and live fire must be completed. This..."
“Weapons are the life of a soldier, and not being familiar with weapons is a disregard for one’s own life. "Zhao Jianfei walked up to him coldly, completed the assembly of the firearm at an extremely fast speed, and quickly shot at the shooting target behind him. Then he said slowly, "This is just the beginning, I ask you to do more than that. After acquiring the weapon, you must become familiar with its performance in the shortest possible time. Because no matter how unified the production of each gun is, their shooting performance will not be absolutely standard. When shooting, the accuracy will vary. This is the time when the shooter is most tested. "
Zhao Jianfei said calmly, "A truly good shooter can complete the debugging of the firearm after firing one or two rounds of bullets, and know how to correct the trajectory by relying on his own touch. This is by no means a simple matter, and what you have to do now is just the basics. "
